text:
alex: Heads-up — proposal to add a small set of runtime metrics for SM GPUs across Hosted + Dedicated so Console + Routing can make decisions: SM_OCCUPANCY, SM_MEM_BYTES_USED, SM_QUEUE_DEPTH. Need owners + tagging contract. cc @maria @kevin

maria: +1. can you sketch the tagset? cardinality is my biggest worry.

alex: Rough draft: ```metric names: SM_OCCUPANCY_gauges, SM_MEM_BYTES_used_gauge, SM_QUEUE_DEPTH_gauge tags: pool_type=(hosted|dedicated), pool_id, zone, model_family, seq_len_bucket, tenant_hash (hashed tenant id)```

kevin: tenant_hash ok. we should NOT include plain tenant_id. also add "schedule_slot" or "slot_class"? Dedicated has reserved slots concept.

sam: For routing decisions we need a headroom metric derived from occupancy + queue depth. Suggest a derived metric: POOL_HEADROOM = max_slots - current_occupied_slots - queued_estimate. compute in telemetry pipeline not the runtime.

alex: Agree. runtime emits raw gauges; ingestion job computes headroom per pool. That keeps runtime simple.

maria: Queue depth needs a percentile distribution or at least p95 and mean; raw instantaneous queue depth can be noisy. We can emit both a gauge and histograms for queue wait times.

kevin: Histograms increase payload size. Option: emit queue_wait_ms_p50/p95 as additional metrics. Lower cardinality than full hist.

sam: For Hosted vs Dedicated: dedicated pools will include slot_class, reserved_commit_id tags. Important for billing and quota dashboards. Hosted should omit commit tag.

alex: Ownership proposals: infra-runtime (kevin) owns the runtime emit; eng-platform (maria + sam) own ingestion transform and dashboard UX; console (me) owns flags and rollout UX.

maria: I'll take dashboard owner. Kevin please review runtime PR for naming. I can design two dashboards — one cross-tenant high-level (by pool_type + zone) and one per-pool exploder with tenant_hash filter.

kevin: Sounds good. One API debate: field names with SM_ prefix vs just gpu_. We already have some gpu_ metrics. Any preference?

alex: I'd prefer gpu_ prefix to be consistent with existing metrics. SM_ came from SM team but runtime uses GPU terminology elsewhere. Let's standardize: gpu_sm_occupancy => gpu_sm_occupancy_gauge, gpu_sm_mem_bytes, gpu_sm_queue_depth.

sam: Rollout plan idea: 1) Emit metrics to staging cluster only for 2 days; 2) Ingest transform runs and fills metrics store; 3) UI surfaces a hidden dashboard; 4) Canary routing uses headroom from metrics for 1% of traffic; 5) evaluate alerts and cost impact; 6) full rollout.

alex: Timeline: can we get runtime change in 2 weeks? kevin?

kevin: 2 weeks for runtime change + tests. I'll add unit tests for tagset and size budget. Need to agree on max telemetry payload per request — suggest <1KB extra.

maria: UX/console needs two alert recipes: low headroom (<3 slots) and sustained high queue depth (p95 > 200ms for 5m). Also add a quota-leak detector when a tenant's queued requests grow while occupancy low (signals stuck queue).

sam: For quotas: we should ensure the per-tenant quota controller can consume these metrics. Add a consumer API: GET /telemetry/pools/{pool_id}/headroom?window=5m returning {p50,p95,free_slots}. We need to decide schema.

alex: Good point. I propose ingestion exposes a minimal internal HTTP API used by routing/quota services. Schema suggestion: keys = strings, values = numbers; fields: pool_id, pool_type, headroom_p50, headroom_p95, timestamp. I'll open a proto PR.

kevin: Keep schema flat and small. No nested objects. Agree to p50/p95 and an epoch ts.

maria: Action items: (1) kevin open runtime PR with metric names and tagset; (2) sam + infra set ingestion job compute for headroom; (3) alex create console dashboard prototype + hidden flag; (4) me design alerts and add to runbook.

alex: I'll create GH issue and link to this thread. Also adding test vectors for payload size limits.

ingest-bot: note: telemetry pipeline quota + retention will be impacted. Current retention for high-card metrics is 7d. Consider 30d for aggregated headroom.

sam: ack. we might downsample per-tenant after 7d but keep pool-level aggregates 30d.

kevin: I'll include a toggle to enable/disable tenant-level emission for Dedicated during initial rollout.

maria: Thanks — tagging owners in the issue: @kevin (runtime), @sam (ingest), @maria (dashboard), @alex (console).

alex: :+1: i'll post the GH link here once created and schedule a quick 30m sync next Tue to finalise tags + rollout windows.

kevin: :eyes: looking forward to the PR.

sam: LGTM

maria: LGTM

alex: closing thread for now — will open issue and ping.
